notes: ACCESS: HTTP-first tier (a) direct requests to apisap.fabindia.com worked throughout for both the CMS nav component (occ/v2/fabindiab2c/cms/components/FabIndiaCategoryNavComponent and .../cms/components?componentIds=...) and the products/search OCC API - no Playwright/browser needed this pass (unlike the prior Textile/Storage pass which used a short Playwright render; this pass reused known-working direct-HTTP endpoints instead). robots.txt (checked in prior passes, re-confirmed unchanged) has no Claude/anthropic-bot disallow. TREE: walked the full FabIndiaCategoryNavComponent JSON tree for keywords bath/shower/toilet/basin/tap/faucet/vanity/sanitary/mirror/hardware/sink/tub. Fabindia sells NO sanitaryware/fixtures (no toilets, basins, taps, tubs, showers) anywhere in its nav - it is an apparel/home-textile/home-decor retailer, not a bath-fixtures brand. Only two nav branches are Bathroom-adjacent: (1) Home & Living > Bath > Bath Accessories (HL4Link -> /home/bath-accessories), and (2) Home Decor > Hardware (H1Link -> /home/hardware, generic decorative wall hooks). QTY/EVIDENCE via products/search?query=:relevance:allCategories:<slug>&pageSize=30&fields=FULL, pagination.totalResults + breadcrumbCategories confirming node identity, plus the Material facet and manual title sampling of all returned product names. Bath Accessories (/home/bath-accessories, totalResults=30, breadcrumb=Home&Living>Bath>Bath Accessories): sampled all 30 titles - 20 are 'Cotton/Cotton Blend Toiletery/Toiletry Bag' (Material facet Cotton=20, confirms; these are travel/personal toiletry pouches, textile, NOT bathroom fixtures/accessories, and were already correctly excluded from Textile.xlsx by the prior textile pass's own notes citing 'majority non-textile' -- they are in fact non-decor personal-carry bags, out of scope for both Textile and Bathroom), 7 are genuine ceramic/glass/stone/marble-mix 'Bath Set' items (soap-dish/dispenser/tray style bathroom accessory sets - in-scope per rule 13 Accessory Sets), 1 is 'Saral Bath Tumbler' (in-scope per rule 13 Tumblers), 1 is 'Gold Nira Metal Trinket' (decorative trinket, ambiguous, not clearly a bath fixture) and 1 is 'Saral Cotton Jar' (ambiguous). No facet, filter-URL, or second nav node exists to isolate an exact count for just the 8 clearly-bathroom items (Material facet only splits Cotton/Metal, leaving the glass/ceramic/stone/marble items untagged and un-isolable via any real crawlable URL; filter-parameter URLs are not treated as genuine subcategory URLs per this company's own established precedent of excluding filtered/collection views). Per rule 29 (ambiguity -> review, do not guess) and the qty rule (no estimating/combining), this mixed node is sent to review rather than recorded as a Bathroom row - recording the raw 30 would falsely include 20 non-bathroom toiletry bags; recording 8 would be an uncited/unverifiable manual split with no supporting URL. Hardware (/home/hardware, totalResults=12, breadcrumb=Home&Living>Home Decor>Hardware): all 12 sampled titles are generic decorative 'Wooden/Ceramic/Brass/Metal Wall Hook' or 'Peg' items with no bath-specific framing anywhere in the node name, breadcrumb, or product titles (contrast with rule 13's 'Bathroom Hooks' which requires bath-intent) - excluded as NOT BATHROOM, logged to review for completeness. CROSS-CATEGORY DEDUP checked via cross_category_url_index.json: /home/bath-mats, /home/bathrobes-slippers, /home/towels, /home/shower-curtains-caps are all already recorded in Textile.xlsx (per rule 20, Bathroom Textiles -> Textile, correct routing, not a Bathroom leaf); /furniture/mirrors (general wall/floor mirrors, not bath-specific) is already recorded in Wall_Decor.xlsx. /home/bath-accessories itself returned no hit in the index (confirmed not previously extracted anywhere), so it is genuinely unclaimed and correctly routed to Bathroom's own review, not a dedup case. RESULT: no confirmed, cleanly-quantifiable Bathroom leaf exists on this site - all candidate content is either textile-owned (dedup), a generic non-bath decor node, or an unresolvably mixed listing. rows=[] is not a NO_CATEGORY finding (rule 36) since genuine bathroom-type products (bath sets, bath tumbler) do exist on-site within that mixed node; it is an ambiguity-review outcome per rule 29.
